binary_raw_output_max_bytes.description: Largest raw binary-tool output accepted (binary triage, debug symbols, CFG, binary intelligence).
binary_raw_output_max_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md B.

container_argv_members_max.description: Most argv entries in one container request.
container_argv_members_max.scale: Pass file lists as files, not argv.

container_bound_cpu_millis.description: Largest CPU quota any container request may ask for.

container_bound_log_bytes.description: Largest stdout/stderr capture any container request may ask for.
container_bound_log_bytes.scale: Build logs: parse the log file rather than raise this.

container_bound_memory_bytes.description: Largest memory limit any container request may ask for.
container_bound_memory_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md C.

container_bound_pids.description: Largest process limit any container request may ask for.

container_bound_timeout_seconds.description: Largest timeout any container request may ask for.
container_bound_timeout_seconds.scale: Engine builds may need more than a day only if not sharded.

container_bound_tmpfs_bytes.description: Largest in-memory /tmp any container request may ask for.

container_destinations_max.description: Most network destinations in one request.

container_mounts_max.description: Most target mounts in one request.

container_result_max_bytes.description: Largest adapter result document read back from a container.

cow_resolver_max_age_days.description: Rebuild the apt/apt-file resolver layer when older than this (same as the Grype/OSV snapshot ceiling).

executor_step_ceiling.description: Largest multiprocess max_concurrent of any job.

handoff_input_max_bytes.description: Largest single input in a job handoff.
handoff_input_max_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md B: hand over references, not bytes.

handoff_total_input_max_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md B.

input_jq_return_bytes.description: Most bytes input_jq returns per call; the model narrows the filter when truncated.

input_line_chars_max.description: Longest line input_read returns; longer lines are cut.

input_read_lines_max.description: Most lines input_read returns per call.
input_read_lines_max.scale: Window; the model asks for the next range.

invoker_inventory_rows_max.description: Above this many inputs, the lookup-mode prompt summarises files by folder; input_list has every row.
invoker_inventory_rows_max.scale: Scales: the summary is per folder.

invoker_timeout_seconds.description: Default wall-clock limit for one claude CLI dispatch.

model_version_resolve_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for resolving pinned model versions.

owasp_join_page_max_bytes.description: Page size when joining OWASP results.

persona_attempt_entries_max.description: Most filesystem entries scanned in one persona attempt tree.
persona_attempt_entries_max.scale: Keep inputs out of attempt trees.

persona_budget_full_input_byte_limit.description: Prompt plus inline inputs a model call may take (inputs above invocation.inline_input_bytes are served by lookup instead) (full budget).
persona_budget_full_input_byte_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_full_input_unit_limit.description: Input tokens a model call may use (full budget).
persona_budget_full_input_unit_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_full_output_byte_limit.description: Bytes a model call may write (full budget).
persona_budget_full_output_byte_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_full_output_file_limit.description: Files a model call may write (full budget).
persona_budget_full_output_file_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_full_output_unit_limit.description: Output tokens a model call may use (full budget).
persona_budget_full_output_unit_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_full_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the model call (full budget).
persona_budget_full_timeout_seconds.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_full_tool_call_limit.description: Tool calls declared in the request budget (lookup tools are granted by the invoker) (full budget).
persona_budget_full_tool_call_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_probe_input_byte_limit.description: Prompt plus inline inputs a model call may take (inputs above invocation.inline_input_bytes are served by lookup instead) (probe budget).
persona_budget_probe_input_byte_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_probe_input_unit_limit.description: Input tokens a model call may use (probe budget).
persona_budget_probe_input_unit_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_probe_output_byte_limit.description: Bytes a model call may write (probe budget).
persona_budget_probe_output_byte_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_probe_output_file_limit.description: Files a model call may write (probe budget).
persona_budget_probe_output_file_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_probe_output_unit_limit.description: Output tokens a model call may use (probe budget).
persona_budget_probe_output_unit_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_probe_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the model call (probe budget).
persona_budget_probe_timeout_seconds.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_probe_tool_call_limit.description: Tool calls declared in the request budget (lookup tools are granted by the invoker) (probe budget).
persona_budget_probe_tool_call_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_standard_input_byte_limit.description: Prompt plus inline inputs a model call may take (inputs above invocation.inline_input_bytes are served by lookup instead) (standard budget).
persona_budget_standard_input_byte_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_standard_input_unit_limit.description: Input tokens a model call may use (standard budget).
persona_budget_standard_input_unit_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_standard_output_byte_limi.description: Bytes a model call may write (standard budget).
persona_budget_standard_output_byte_limi.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_standard_output_file_limi.description: Files a model call may write (standard budget).
persona_budget_standard_output_file_limi.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_standard_output_unit_limi.description: Output tokens a model call may use (standard budget).
persona_budget_standard_output_unit_limi.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_standard_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the model call (standard budget).
persona_budget_standard_timeout_seconds.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_budget_standard_tool_call_limit.description: Tool calls declared in the request budget (lookup tools are granted by the invoker) (standard budget).
persona_budget_standard_tool_call_limit.scale: Index-first keeps model calls small at any target size.

persona_manifest_max_bytes.description: Largest output manifest a persona invoker may write.

persona_producers_max.description: Most producer invocations a reviewing invocation may name.

persona_readable_inputs_logged.description: Former cap on readable inputs per model request; now only logged.
persona_readable_inputs_logged.scale: Freeciv21: 6,100; engine: ~100K. Served through the index.

persona_result_max_bytes.description: Largest persona result/record document read back.

persona_tools_max.description: Most tool ids one persona request may allow.

pool_docker_slots.description: Dagster `docker` pool slots: pinned-container and target-execution ops that may run at once across all runs. Applied by the resource_pool_guard sensor.
pool_docker_slots.scale: At 1, one long scan (doom3-bfg scancode, up to an hour) held every other run's container work; each slot can take up to 4 GiB / 2 CPUs (30 GB / 16 cores on zarathustra).

pool_document_max_bytes.description: Largest pool specification or pool input document.
pool_document_max_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md B.

pool_group_count_max.description: Largest count in one worker group.
pool_group_count_max.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md D.

pool_groups_max.description: Most worker groups in one pool specification.
pool_groups_max.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md D.

pool_instances_max.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md D: hundreds of engine modules.

pool_persona_llm_slots.description: Dagster `persona_llm` pool slots: model invocations that may run at once across all runs. Applied by the resource_pool_guard sensor.
pool_persona_llm_slots.scale: Cross-run limit: must stay below runs_concurrent_max x executor_step_ceiling (6) or it constrains nothing. Model calls are remote; local cost is one claude CLI + MCP input server per slot.

pool_total_timeout_max_seconds.description: Largest total timeout of a pool.

redaction_max_file_bytes.description: Largest single file the evidence redactor processes; larger files are withheld.
redaction_max_file_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md B.

redaction_max_files.description: Most files in one published tree; more refuses publication.
redaction_max_files.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md B (tool output trees).

redaction_max_json_depth.description: JSON nesting depth the redactor parses (hard ceiling 200).

redaction_max_line_length.description: Longest line the redactor scans; longer lines withhold the file.

redaction_max_path_length.description: Longest relative path the redactor accepts.
redaction_max_path_length.scale: Deep engine trees may need more.

redaction_max_total_bytes.description: Total bytes redacted per tree; the rest is withheld.
redaction_max_total_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md B.

result_artifact_max_bytes.description: Largest declared result JSON validate_job_output will load and schema-check (loaded whole into memory).
result_artifact_max_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md B: large producers publish a summary plus a records file instead.

runs_concurrent_max.description: Concurrent Dagster runs. Enforced by orchestrator/dagster/dagster.yaml (QueuedRunCoordinator max_concurrent_runs); keep the two equal. Extra launches queue.
runs_concurrent_max.scale: Host-bound: 30 GB RAM / 16 cores on zarathustra; Joern alone takes up to 8 GB per run.

snapshot_files_max.description: Most files in an extracted snapshot.
